import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

    'age': 'patient_age',
    'sex': 'gender',
    'bmi': 'body_mass_index',

    's1': 'serum_s1',
    's2': 'serum_s2',

}
data.rename(columns=column_renaming, inplace=True)

# Assume disease progression score above 150 indicates an event occurrence

data['event_occurred'] = (data['disease_progression'] > threshold).astype(int)

# Save the mutated dataset
data.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)

# Save the mutated dataset
